The '''Capital''' was a model of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] produced by [[Tirsa Wargear]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Tirsa Capital was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[June 9]], [[2015]] as one of the items in the Mid Rim Explorer's Pack on the Cartel Market.

*[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] {{1st}}
